Showing all verified alumni

New alumnus sign-up

Submitted details go to the verification queue — a batch rep confirms your batch, and your city coordinator confirms your current details, before login access is granted.

Speed this up (optional)

We'll extract your name, batch, company, position and city from the CV so you can review instead of retyping — you confirm everything before it's submitted. Demo only: this prototype fills sample values rather than truly reading your file.

Admin/coordinator view — demo only. In production this is restricted to logged-in batch reps, city coordinators and central admins.
Queue is clear
No sign-ups waiting on verification right now.
Admin/coordinator view — demo only. A chapter groups several districts (even across states) under one meet-up, e.g. Delhi NCR covers Delhi + Faridabad & Gurugram (Haryana) + Ghaziabad & Gautam Buddha Nagar (UP).

Chapter definitions

Add a district to a chapter

Pick any state and district, choose which chapter it belongs to (or start a new one), and every alumnus in that district is grouped into it automatically. Everyone newly mapped to a chapter — and anyone moved out of one — is emailed automatically.

Rename a chapter

Renaming also notifies everyone currently mapped to it.

Notification log

Simulated — every chapter change below queues an automated email to each affected alumnus's registered address. No real emails are sent from this prototype.

Attendance log

Vamnians is an independent alumni initiative for VAMNICOM — Vaikunth Mehta National Institute of Cooperative Management, Pune, a National Institute of the National Council for Cooperative Training, Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India. This is a prototype for the VAMNICOM alumni directory strategy, not an official Institute or Government portal. Directory records (name, batch, city, company, designation) are from the 2014 alumni database export; phone numbers and email addresses from that file are not included here. Verification queue entries and login credentials are illustrative, not real.
